title: Gallery Generator for PBC
start_greater_than_end: Start number cannot be greater than end number.
missing_hash: Filename must contain a '#' to indicate where the number goes.
invalid_prefix: Filename must start with 'File:', 'Media:', or have no prefix.
invalid_extension: Invalid file extension: {{extension}}. Allowed extensions are: {{allowed_extensions}}.
base_name_help: Enter the file name in the format 'Image #.jpg'. The '#' symbol is required as it indicates where the number will be inserted. For example, 'Photo #.jpg' would generate 'Photo 001.jpg', 'Photo 002.jpg', etc. Supported extensions are: png, jpg, jpeg, webp, svg, pdf, ogg, ogv, oga, flac, opus, wav, webm, mp3, midi, mid, mpg, mpeg
start_num_help: This is the number where the file numbering will begin. For example, if you enter '1', the first file will be 'Photo 001.jpg'. Ensure it's a positive number.
end_num_help: This is the number where the file numbering will end. For example, if you enter '10', the last file will be 'Photo 010.jpg'. Ensure it's a positive number greater than or equal to the start number.
num_length_help: Specify how many digits the file number should have. For example, if you choose '3', the generated numbers will be '001', '002', and so on. If you choose '2', the numbers will be '01', '02', etc.
tabber_title_help: Enter the title for the gallery tab. This title will be displayed as the tab's name in the gallery. Make sure it describes the content of the gallery.
tabber_mode_help: Choose whether this gallery is the first one or an additional one to be added. If it's the first gallery, select 'First gallery'. If you're adding it to an existing gallery, select 'Add to the end'.
summary: Build a wiki gallery from a numbered file pattern.
range_too_large: Range is too large. Maximum {{max}} files per gallery.
